title: Creamy Kenyan Skillet Dumplings
description: A hearty and comforting Kenyan-inspired dish featuring dumplings cooked in a creamy skillet. Perfect for a cozy evening meal.
instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute.
Add chili powder and cumin; stir to combine.
Meanwhile, prepare dumpling wrappers according to package instructions.
Dumplings to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Transfer dumplings to a plate and cover with cheese.
Return skillet to heat and stir to melt cheese.
